messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: SEV2 embedder-latency spike in us-west-2 — hosted responses >3s on several routes. link: https://pager.redwood/alerts/82345 

alex_k: Copy. I'm up. Which routes are showing the worst latency?

maria_s: api/embed and api/chat-embed. Observed client retries +12% 5xx. Logs: `embedder: latency p95 4.2s`, memory pressure on prod-gpu-03.

sam_irwin: I'm oncall, taking lead. Switching live mitigation to runbook "embedder-latency-mitigation". @alex_k can you check GPU pool utilisation? @maria_s check routing fallback and cache TTLs.

alex_k: SSH'd to prod-gpu-03 — GPU mem 98%, one model process hogging VRAM. Rolling restart of model worker (graceful). Command: `systemctl restart rw-embedder@a`.

elena_pm: CS flagged two hosted customers hitting timeouts; tickets opened. Keeping me in loop for comms.

oncall-bot: Handoff note: sam_irwin -> priya_g at 07:30 UTC for shift overlap.

priya_g: Ack taking over at 07:30. Short summary pls.

sam_irwin: Summary: memory regression causing OOM/slowdowns. Mitigations applied: scale burst pool +4 GPUs, enable fallback to quantized model variant (v2-q), flush small-prefix KV cache. Scaling in progress.

maria_s: Scaling completed, autoscaler spun up 4 nodes. p95 reduced to ~1.8s after fallback enabled.

sam_irwin: Good. Continue monitoring 30m. If stable we close pager and move to post-incident flow.

jordan_ops: Drafting action items now — will create tickets after stabilization: 
- ACTION 1: investigate model memory regression (owner: alex_k, estimate: 2d, label: incident,sev2)
- ACTION 2: adjust autoscale thresholds to avoid slow spin-up (owner: priya_g, estimate: 4h)
- ACTION 3: add circuit-breaker + early-fail routing for impacted routes (owner: maria_s, estimate: 1d)
- ACTION 4: update runbook and add explicit fallback test (owner: maria_s, estimate: 1d)

elena_pm: Let's prioritize by customer impact: ACTION1 = high, ACTION2 = medium, ACTION3 = high (prevents retries), ACTION4 = low. Tag for Q3 reliability OKR.

sam_irwin: Postmortem schedule: propose tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Invite SRE, ML infra, product, CS. I'll create calendar + initial notes in the incident board.

alex_k: Creating ticket now: `gh issue create --title "investigate model memory regression" --assignees alex_k --label incident,sev2 --body "OOMs started after model v3.2 deploy; capture heap and allocator traces"`.

priya_g: PR out to change autoscale policy: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 — adds faster warmup and lower scale threshold for embedder pool.

maria_s: Adding runbook snippet for forced fallback and test commands. Example command to trigger fallback locally: `curl -X POST /test/fallback -d '{"target":"embedder"}'`

elena_pm: For customer comms: I'll wait for postmortem outcomes then propose targeted credits if SLA hit confirmed.

sam_irwin: Current metrics: p95 1.6s, error rate down to baseline. Plan: keep monitoring 30m, then resolve pager. If any regressions, re-open and escalate. Anyone object to the postmortem time?

priya_g: Works for me.

alex_k: fine.

maria_s: ok :thumbsup: 

jordan_ops: I'll convert the actions into GH issues and link to the incident board, include estimates and severity tags.

elena_pm: Thanks. Please include a column for OKR mapping (Q3 reliability).

sam_irwin: Closing note — nice mitigation teamwork. Leaving follow-ups as tickets; postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

all: +1
